items.title: Nvidia Probe Puts China Exposed US Chip Stocks In Focus
items.summary: Geopolitics just crashed into the chip aisle. Nvidia’s internal probe into CEO Jensen Huang and fresh scrutiny around China-linked AI hardware sales are turning abstract export rules into very real portfolio questions. That disruption can punish some stocks and open the door for others. This article walks through three large US semiconductor and chip-equipment picks exposed to this news and explains how the risks and potential openings could matter for you. items.title: Taiwan shares rally 6% as short-sale curbs and NT$500 bln fund lift sentiment
items.summary: Investing.com -- Taiwan stocks rebounded sharply on Monday, ending a seven-session losing streak that had pushed the technology-heavy market into bear-market territory, as new restrictions on short selling and government support measures helped restore investor confidence.
